board.card.bringBack.description: Menu item (a card's right-click menu) and button (its dialog) on an archived card: brings it back to the board.

board.details.provider.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the agent's CLI follows (Claude Code, Codex…).

board.details.revision.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the card's revision follows, the version of the card's work the run was for: a commit id, or for a project with no platform a hash of the card's files' content (not a commit).

board.details.run.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the run's title follows.

board.details.staleAgentStopped.defaultMessage: Stopped reporting: its agent stopped before it finished
board.details.staleAgentStopped.description: A run's state in its details (Progress panel): the agent that ran it stopped first.

board.details.staleQuiet.description: A run's state in its details (Progress panel): no news from it for {quiet} ("12 min").

board.details.started.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): a date and time follows.

board.details.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, running {Running} failed {Failed} passed {Passed} other {Stopped}}{dismissed, select, yes { (dismissed)} other {}}
board.details.state.description: A run's state in its details (Progress panel): running, failed or passed; then " (dismissed)" when the user dismissed the run.

board.details.stateLabel.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): its state follows (Running, Failed…).

board.details.steps.description: A run's details in the Progress panel, its steps: {done} of {total} steps done.

board.details.stepsLabel.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): its steps follow ("4 of 12 done").

board.details.stepsLast.description: A run's details in the Progress panel, its steps: {done} of {total} steps done, and the last step reported ({step}, as the reporter named it).

board.details.summary.description: A label in a run's details copied as text (Copy details, Progress panel): the summary its reporter gave follows.

board.details.testedOn.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel), shown when it differs from the card's revision: the commit that was checked out where the run ran follows (a commit id).

board.details.took.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): how long it ran follows.

board.details.tookSoFar.defaultMessage: {took} so far{expected, select, none {} other { · expected about {expected}}}
board.details.tookSoFar.description: How long a run that is still going has run, in its details (Progress panel): {took} ("4 min"), then about how long runs like it take ({expected}, a duration, or none when unknown: keep that branch empty).

board.details.tookTotal.description: How long a finished run took, in its details (Progress panel): {took} ("4 min"), then about how long runs like it take ({expected}, a duration, or none when unknown: keep that branch empty).

board.details.waitingSince.description: A run's state in its details (Progress panel): waiting since a date and time ({since}) for what its reporter says ({waiting}, in its own words: "a test slot").

board.dialog.addCard.description: The New Card dialog's main button: adds the card.

board.dialog.added.defaultMessage: {who, select, you {Added by you} assistant {Added by the Assistant} repair {Added by Repair} other {Added by {by}}} {added} · changed {changed}
board.dialog.added.description: At the foot of the card dialog: who added the card ({who}: you, the user; assistant, the Hive Assistant; repair, Hive's Repair, which gives cards back to a moved project; other: an agent, {by} its name), when ({added}: "3 days ago"), and when it last changed ({changed}).

board.dialog.addedUnknown.description: At the foot of the card dialog when who added the card isn't known: when it was added ({added}: "3 days ago") and last changed ({changed}).

board.dialog.adding.description: A button while a new card or decision is being added.

board.dialog.agent.description: A field label in the card dialog: the agent the card is given to.

board.dialog.agentStatus.description: An agent in the card dialog's agent choice, with what it is doing ({status}: "Working…").

board.dialog.archivedBanner.defaultMessage: {cause, select, hidden {Archived when {project} was hidden.} removed {Archived when {project} was removed from Hive.} done {Archived automatically after its days in Done (Settings → Board).} other {Archived.}} Bring it back to change it.
board.dialog.archivedBanner.description: A banner in an archived card's dialog: why it was archived (its project {project} hidden or removed, or after its days in the Done column: Settings → Board is where that is set), and that it must be brought back to be changed.

board.dialog.archiving.description: A button while cards are being archived.

board.dialog.blocked.description: A field label in the card dialog: why the card can't go on (empty: it isn't blocked).

board.dialog.blockedPlaceholder.defaultMessage: Why it can't go on (empty: not blocked)
board.dialog.blockedPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's Blocked box: why the card can't go on; empty means it isn't blocked.

board.dialog.bringingBack.description: The Bring Back button while the archived card is being brought back.

board.dialog.cancel.description: Button: closes a board dialog without doing anything.

board.dialog.column.description: A field label in the card dialog: the board column the card is in.

board.dialog.comment.description: Button in the card dialog: posts the comment written above.

board.dialog.commentPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's comment box.

board.dialog.comments.description: A heading in the card dialog: the card's comments, and how many ({n}).

board.dialog.context.description: A field label in the card dialog (#818): doc sections the card's agent reads before starting, given in its start prompt.

board.dialog.contextPlaceholder.defaultMessage: Doc sections, one a line: docs/PLAN.md#setup, shared:plans/notes.md#open-questions
board.dialog.contextPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's Read first box (#818): references to doc sections, one a line (keep the examples as they are).

board.dialog.creatingWorktree.description: A button while a card is being started on a new agent in its own git worktree (making the worktree takes a moment).

board.dialog.delete.description: Button in the card dialog: deletes the card (after asking).

board.dialog.dependsOn.description: A field label in the card dialog: the cards to finish before this one.

board.dialog.dependsOnPlaceholder.defaultMessage: Cards to finish first, e.g. AM-3 AM-5
board.dialog.dependsOnPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's Depends on box: cards by name (AM-3 AM-5 are examples: a project key, a hyphen and a number; #3 works too).

board.dialog.description.description: A heading in the card dialog: the card's description.

board.dialog.descriptionPlaceholder.defaultMessage: What to do, and how to tell it's done (Markdown). Whoever starts the card reads only this.
board.dialog.descriptionPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's description box.

board.dialog.history.description: A heading in the card dialog (click to show or hide): the card's history of changes, and how many entries ({n}).

board.dialog.labels.description: A field label in the card dialog: the card's labels.

board.dialog.labelsPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's labels box: labels separated by commas (bug and ui are examples).

board.dialog.needsProject.defaultMessage: Give it a project first: its agent works there.
board.dialog.needsProject.description: Why a card with no project can't be started (a tooltip, and the Start dialog).

board.dialog.needsTitle.description: An error in the card dialog: Save with an empty title.

board.dialog.newComment.description: Accessible name of the box where a comment is written (card dialog).

board.dialog.noDescription.defaultMessage: No description. Double-click to write one.
board.dialog.noDescription.description: The card dialog's description preview when there is none.

board.dialog.noProject.description: The card dialog's project choice for a card of no project: it is about the whole workspace.

board.dialog.nobodyYet.description: No agent has the card: the card dialog's agent choice, and a choice of the Move to Doing dialog.

board.dialog.posting.description: The Comment button while the comment is being posted.

board.dialog.preview.description: A tab button in the card dialog: show the description as it reads (Markdown rendered).

board.dialog.project.description: A field label in the card dialog: the card's project.

board.dialog.projectGone.description: The card dialog's project choice when the card's project ({project}) is no longer in the workspace.

board.dialog.related.description: A field label in the card dialog: related cards.

board.dialog.relatedPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's Related box: cards by name (AM-7 is an example: a project key, a hyphen and a number).

board.dialog.save.description: Button: saves the card (or a changed decision).

board.dialog.saveAndStart.description: Button in the card dialog with unsaved changes: saves them, then asks which agent starts the card.

board.dialog.savePostsIt.description: Beside the Comment button once something is written: the card dialog's Save button posts the comment as well.

board.dialog.saving.description: A button while the card (or a decision) is being saved.

board.dialog.start.description: Button in the card dialog: asks which agent starts the card.

board.dialog.startButton.description: Button of the Start dialog (and of Move to Doing with Assign and start): starts the card on the chosen agent.

board.dialog.startTip.defaultMessage: Give it to an agent, with the card as its prompt.
board.dialog.startTip.description: Tooltip on the card dialog's Start… button.

board.dialog.startTipSave.defaultMessage: Save your changes, then give it to an agent with the card as its prompt.
board.dialog.startTipSave.description: Tooltip on the card dialog's Save and Start… button.

board.dialog.starting.description: A button while a card is being started on an agent.

board.dialog.titlePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's title box.

board.dialog.tryAgain.description: A board dialog's main button after it failed: does it again.

board.dialog.write.description: A tab button in the card dialog: edit the description's Markdown.

board.discard.answer.description: What closing the card dialog would lose, in "Closing loses {what}.": an answer to a request for the user (For you) not sent yet. Lower case.

board.discard.changes.description: What closing the card dialog would lose, in "Closing loses {what}.": changed fields. Lower case.

board.discard.comment.description: What closing the card dialog would lose, in "Closing loses {what}.": a comment not posted. Lower case.

board.discard.decision.description: What closing the card dialog would lose, in "Closing loses {what}.": a decision not added. Lower case.

board.discard.decisionChange.description: What closing the card dialog would lose, in "Closing loses {what}.": a decision changed and not saved. Lower case.

board.discard.discard.description: Button: closes the card dialog, losing what was not saved.

board.discard.keep.description: Button: goes back to the card dialog, nothing lost.

board.discard.message.description: When the card dialog closes with something not saved: {what} lists what would be lost ("your changes to the card and the comment you are writing").

board.discard.newCard.description: What closing the card dialog would lose, in "Closing loses {what}.": a card not added yet. Lower case.

board.discard.title.description: Title of the question when the card dialog closes with something not saved.

board.doing.agent.description: A field label in the Move to Doing dialog: which agent gets the card.

board.doing.agentStatus.description: An agent in the Move to Doing dialog's agent choice, with what it is doing ({status}: "Working…", "Stopped").

board.doing.assign.description: A choice in the Move to Doing dialog: give the card to an agent without starting anything.

board.doing.assignText.defaultMessage: Gives it to an agent of the project. Nothing is sent to the agent and nothing starts.
board.doing.assignText.description: Under "Assign an agent" in the Move to Doing dialog.

board.doing.button.description: The Move to Doing dialog's button: moves the card into the Doing column (a board column).

board.doing.moving.description: The Move to Doing button while the card is being moved.

board.doing.noAgents.defaultMessage: The project has no agents yet.
board.doing.noAgents.description: Under "Assign an agent" in the Move to Doing dialog (off) when the project has no agents.

board.doing.nobody.description: Under "Nobody yet" in the Move to Doing dialog.

board.doing.nobodyFrom.defaultMessage: Moves it with no agent. Takes it from {agent}.
board.doing.nobodyFrom.description: Under "Nobody yet" in the Move to Doing dialog, when the card has an agent ({agent}, its name).

board.doing.start.description: A choice in the Move to Doing dialog: give the card to an agent and start it on the card.

board.doing.startText.defaultMessage: The agent gets the card as its prompt: a stopped one starts a new conversation, an idle one gets it as its next message.
board.doing.startText.description: Under "Assign and start" in the Move to Doing dialog.

board.doing.stopped.description: An agent's state in the Move to Doing dialog's agent choice: its session isn't running.

board.doing.title.description: Title of the Move to Doing dialog: {card} is the card's name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none. Doing is a board column.

board.duration.hours.description: A short duration in whole hours ("2 h"), in the Progress panel and on cards. Keep it short: an abbreviation.

board.duration.hoursMinutes.description: A short duration in hours and minutes ("1 h 5 min"), in the Progress panel and on cards. Keep it short: abbreviations.

board.duration.minutes.description: A short duration in minutes ("4 min"), in the Progress panel and on cards. Keep it short: an abbreviation.

board.duration.seconds.description: A short duration in seconds ("40 s"), in the Progress panel and on cards. Keep it short: an abbreviation.

board.error.archive.description: An error toast's title: archiving a card failed.

board.error.change.description: An error toast's title: changing a card failed.

board.error.inUse.defaultMessage: Another Hive has this workspace open: close it first.
board.error.inUse.description: An error: the board can't be upgraded to 1.0 (or its 0.9 backup put back) while another copy of Hive (an older version, or another profile) has the workspace open. Nothing was changed.

board.error.move.description: An error toast's title: moving a card to another column failed.

board.error.newer.defaultMessage: This board was saved by a newer version of Hive. It is shown read-only: update Hive to change it.
board.error.newer.description: An error: the workspace's task board was saved by a newer Hive, whose format this version doesn't know; cards can be read but not changed.

board.error.noBackup.defaultMessage: There is no 0.9 board backup to put back: this board was never upgraded to 1.0 here.
board.error.noBackup.description: An error from Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup…: no copy of the board from before its upgrade to Hive 1.0 is kept in the workspace.

board.error.noWorkspace.description: An error: the task board needs an open workspace, and there is none.

board.error.stopAgentsFirst.defaultMessage: Stop this workspace's agents and its Assistant first: once the 0.9 board is back, Hive can't record them.
board.error.stopAgentsFirst.description: An error from Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup…: agents of the workspace are running or starting; the board put back is read-only in this Hive, so their sessions couldn't be recorded. Nothing was changed.

board.error.unarchive.defaultMessage: Could not bring the card back
board.error.unarchive.description: An error toast's title: bringing an archived card back to the board failed.

board.error.unavailable.description: An error: the workspace's task board database couldn't be opened or its cards couldn't be moved into it; {error} says why (from the system, often in English). Nothing was lost: the cards are still where they were.

board.error.upgradeFirst.defaultMessage: This board is from Hive 0.9: it is read-only until it is upgraded to 1.0 (Upgrade… on the board's banner).
board.error.upgradeFirst.description: An error: the workspace's task board hasn't been upgraded to Hive 1.0's format yet (the user was asked and said not now), so cards can be read but not changed. Upgrade… is the button on the banner above the board.

board.error.upgradeFirstStart.defaultMessage: This workspace is from Hive 0.9: upgrade it to 1.0 before starting agents (Upgrade… on the banner at the top of the window).
board.error.upgradeFirstStart.description: An error: an agent (or the Assistant) can't start while the workspace's data waits for its upgrade to Hive 1.0's format (the user said Not Now): Hive couldn't record its session. Upgrade… is the button on the banner at the top of the window.

board.export.command.description: A command (the board's ⋯ menu, the command palette): saves every card of the board as a JSON file, in a new folder inside one the user picks. The … says it asks first: keep it.

board.export.done.defaultMessage: Exported {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}
board.export.done.description: A notification after Export Board to JSON: how many cards were saved.

board.export.failed.description: A notification: Export Board to JSON failed (why follows).

board.field.agent.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your agent replaced the change made meanwhile"). Lower case.

board.field.blocked.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your blocked replaced the change made meanwhile"): why it can't go on. Lower case.

board.field.blockedBy.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your dependencies replaced the change made meanwhile"): the cards it depends on (the dialog's Depends on). Lower case.

board.field.column.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your column replaced the change made meanwhile"): the board column it is in. Lower case.

board.field.context.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your doc sections to read first replaced the change made meanwhile"): its Read first references. Lower case.

board.field.description.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your title, description replaced the change made meanwhile"). Lower case.

board.field.labels.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your labels replaced the change made meanwhile"). Lower case.

board.field.links.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your links replaced the change made meanwhile"): its related cards. Lower case.

board.field.project.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your project replaced the change made meanwhile"). Lower case.

board.field.title.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your title, labels replaced the change made meanwhile"). Lower case.

board.filter.noProject.description: A choice of the Progress panel's project filter: the runs of the Hive Assistant and of scripts, which belong to no project.

board.forYou.answering.description: A button while the user's answer to a request is being recorded.

board.forYou.approve.description: A button under a request for the user's approval (For you): approves it. Glossary: approve.

board.forYou.asDecision.description: A button under a question for the user (For you): records the answer typed above as one of the card's decisions (a new decision, which its agents read), and answers the question with it.

board.forYou.asked.description: Under a request for the user in the card dialog: who asks (Hive, or an agent: its name {who}) and when ({when}: "5 min ago"). Keep the select keys as they are.

board.forYou.checklist.description: Above the checklist of a Test request (For you): what the user is asked to try.

board.forYou.chip.description: A chip on a board card: something on the card waits for the user (an approval, a decision, a question). Glossary: For you.

board.forYou.chipTip.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Waits for you: {requests}} other {# requests wait for you: {requests}}}
board.forYou.chipTip.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a card's For you chip: how many requests wait for the user ({n}) and each one, its kind and what it asks ({requests}, separated by · ). Glossary: For you.

board.forYou.decline.description: A button under a request for the user's approval (For you): declines it, asking why first (…). For the user's review, the card goes back to its builder as a round.

board.forYou.declineNeeds.defaultMessage: Say why, so the agent knows what to change.
board.forYou.declineNeeds.description: An error in the question when the user declines a request without a reason: one is needed.

board.forYou.declineTitle.description: Title of the question when the user declines a request (For you); {request} is what it asks.

board.forYou.declineWhy.defaultMessage: Why? The agent waiting on it reads your reason.
board.forYou.declineWhy.description: The question when the user declines a request for their approval: their reason, which the waiting agent is told.

board.forYou.failed.description: An error toast's title: the user's answer to a request (For you) was refused, perhaps answered or retired meanwhile (a new submission, the card moved on). Its text says why.

board.forYou.heading.description: A heading in the card dialog, above what on the card waits for the user (approvals, decisions, questions). Glossary: For you.

board.forYou.reply.description: The label (and placeholder) of the box under a question for the user (For you) in the card dialog: the user's answer, sent to the agent that asked.

board.forYou.rounds.description: The label of the number box beside Carry on, at a card loop's round limit: how many more review rounds the card gets.

board.forYou.send.description: A button under a question for the user (For you): sends the answer typed above to the agent that asked.

board.inbox.asks.description: An agent in the attention inbox has asked the user a question.

board.inbox.asksWhat.description: An agent in the attention inbox has asked the user a question ({message}, in the agent's own words).

board.inbox.assistant.description: The Hive Assistant, named in the attention inbox (status bar popover, tray menu) where a project name goes. Hive is the app's name: keep it.

board.inbox.changes.description: Button on a worktree agent's row in the inbox: shows its changes in the Git tab.

board.inbox.commits.description: A worktree agent's unmerged commits, in the attention inbox ("2 commits").

board.inbox.diff.description: A worktree agent's unmerged changes, in the attention inbox: how many files differ from its base branch, and the lines added (+) and removed (−).

board.inbox.failed.description: An agent in the attention inbox failed to start.

board.inbox.failedWhy.description: An agent in the attention inbox failed to start; {message} is why (an error's first line).

board.inbox.finished.description: An agent in the attention inbox finished its turn and the user has not looked at it since.

board.inbox.merge.description: Button on a worktree agent's row in the inbox: opens the merge dialog for its branch.

board.inbox.needYouCount.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# needs you} other {# need you}}
board.inbox.needYouCount.description: The status bar's inbox item: how many agents wait for the user or finished unseen ("2 need you"). Keep it short.

board.inbox.needYouEmptyHeading.description: Heading in the inbox popover above the agents that wait for the user, when there are none.

board.inbox.needYouHeading.description: Heading in the inbox popover above the agents that wait for the user, with how many ({n}).

board.inbox.needYouTip.defaultMessage: Agents waiting for you or finished since you last looked
board.inbox.needYouTip.description: Tooltip of the status bar's inbox item ("2 need you").

board.inbox.needsInput.description: An agent in the attention inbox waits for the user's answer.

board.inbox.needsInputWhat.description: An agent in the attention inbox waits for the user's answer; {message} is what its CLI shows (its own words).

board.inbox.nothing.description: The inbox popover when no agent waits for the user.

board.inbox.panel.description: The inbox popover's accessible name (above the status bar).

board.inbox.safeguard.description: An agent in the attention inbox whose CLI's safety classifier stopped a response.

board.inbox.safeguardSwitched.defaultMessage: After a safeguard stop: Now runs on {to} instead of {from}
board.inbox.safeguardSwitched.description: An agent in the attention inbox whose CLI's safety classifier stopped a response, so it moved to another model: {to} and {from} are the models' names.

board.inbox.toReview.description: A worktree agent in the attention inbox has unmerged work for the user to review.

board.inbox.toReviewCount.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# to review} other {# to review}}
board.inbox.toReviewCount.description: The status bar's inbox item: how many worktree agents have work for the user to review ("1 to review"). Keep it short.

board.inbox.toReviewHeading.description: Heading in the inbox popover above worktree agents whose work waits for the user's review, with how many ({n}).

board.inbox.toReviewTip.defaultMessage: Worktree agents with work to review
board.inbox.toReviewTip.description: Tooltip of the status bar's inbox item when only worktree agents' work waits ("1 to review").

board.inbox.uncommitted.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# uncommitted file} other {# uncommitted files}}
board.inbox.uncommitted.description: A worktree agent's files with changes not committed yet, in the attention inbox ("1 uncommitted file").

board.kind.anyway.description: The button of the question before a card's kind is changed: makes the change, recorded as an override (glossary: override).

board.kind.askDetail.defaultMessage: Changing it anyway records an override on the card, with your reason.
board.kind.askDetail.description: Under the rule a kind change skips, in the question before it: the change is recorded on the card as an exception to the rules (glossary: override), with the reason the user gives below.

board.kind.askMessage.defaultMessage: This skips a rule of its project:
board.kind.askMessage.description: The question before a card's kind is changed after it was made: the rule it skips is listed below (its name).

board.kind.askTitle.defaultMessage: {kind, select, code {Make {card} code?} other {Make {card} no code?}}
board.kind.askTitle.description: Title of the question before a card's kind is changed after it was made. {kind} is the kind it would get (select keys), {card} the card's name.

board.kind.change.defaultMessage: {kind, select, code {Make It No Code…} other {Make It Code…}}
board.kind.change.description: A button beside a card's kind in its dialog: changes it to the other kind, asking first (…): an exception to the card's rules. Select keys: the kind it is now.

board.kind.code.description: A card's kind in its dialog: work in commits (the default). Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.confirm.description: A button on the banner of a card an agent proposed as no code: makes it no code.

board.kind.failed.description: An error toast's title: changing or confirming a card's kind failed. Its text says why.

board.kind.field.description: A field label in the card dialog: the card's kind, code (work in commits) or no code (a decision, a write-up, a trial). Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.keep.description: A button on the banner of a card an agent proposed as no code: keeps it code (work in commits).

board.kind.newChoice.defaultMessage: No code (a decision, a write-up, a trial…)
board.kind.newChoice.description: A tick box in the New Card dialog: the card's work has no commits; it is submitted with a summary. Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.noCode.description: A card's kind (a mark on its tile, and in its dialog): work with no commits, such as a decision, a write-up or a trial; it is submitted with a summary. Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.noCodeTip.defaultMessage: No code: its work is a decision, a write-up or a trial, submitted with a summary and no commits.
board.kind.noCodeTip.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a card's No code mark (on its tile). Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.proposal.defaultMessage: No code? The agent that made this card proposes it: its work has no commits (a decision, a write-up, a trial).
board.kind.proposal.description: A banner in a card's dialog: the agent that made the card proposed it as no code, and the user is to confirm it or keep it as code. Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.proposedTip.defaultMessage: No code? Proposed by the agent that made it: open the card to confirm it.
board.kind.proposedTip.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a card's mark when an agent proposed it as no code (no commits) and nobody has answered yet. Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.reason.description: The label of the field in the question before a card's kind is changed: why the user makes the exception. Optional.

board.kind.working.description: A button while the card's kind is being saved.

board.lane.afterRound.description: Where a lane's finished card is, in its segment's label (Progress panel): its column ({where}, "Passed" or "Done") and the review round it passed in ({round}, a number above 1).

board.lane.andMore.description: The last item of a folded lane segment's list of cards (Progress panel), after the first eight card numbers: how many more there are ({n}). Hive joins it to the list ("#1, #2 … #8 and 3 more").

board.lane.blocked.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel (its hover): the card is blocked, with no reason given. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.blockedReason.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel (its hover): the card is blocked, and why, in the user's or an agent's own words ({reason}). {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.finished.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel) for its finished cards folded into one: how many ({n}) and which ({cards}: "#3, #4").

board.lane.foldedMark.description: A line in the hover of a lane segment that folds several cards ("✓ 6", "+4", Progress panel): one card's mark. {card} is its name (its key, such as AL-12), {mark} what the mark says, a sentence already translated (a refusal, a stale pass, a move past its rules).

board.lane.goneWhenEnded.defaultMessage: {card} · not on the board when the lane ended
board.lane.goneWhenEnded.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel), in a lane that has ended: the card wasn't on the board then. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.holdReason.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel (its hover): the card is On Hold (a board column), and why, in the user's own words ({reason}). {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.holdWaiting.defaultMessage: {card}: On Hold: waiting for you to move it on
board.lane.holdWaiting.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel (its hover): the card is On Hold (a board column) until the user moves it. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.holdWaitingShort.description: Where a lane's card is, in its segment's label (Progress panel): On Hold (a board column) until the user moves it on.

board.lane.inRound.description: Where a lane's card is, in its segment's label (Progress panel): its column ({where}, "Doing" or "Review") and the review round it is in ({round}, a number).

board.lane.label.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel): the card’s name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title (the user's own words) and where it is ({where}: "Review, round 2").

board.lane.labelWhenEnded.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel), in a lane that has ended: the card’s name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title (the user's own words) and where it was then ({where}: "Review, round 2").

board.lane.more.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel) for the cards that don't fit its bar, folded into one: how many ({n}) and which ({cards}: "#3, #4").

board.lane.notOnBoard.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel) for a card that isn't on the board (archived or deleted). {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.openForMore.defaultMessage: Click to open the card for the rest
board.lane.openForMore.description: The last line of a lane segment's hover (Progress panel), under what its facts say: clicking the segment opens the card, which shows everything.

board.lane.reviewFailed.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel (its hover, under a red underline): the card's review round {round} failed and the next round ({next}) hasn't started. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.reviewerGist.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel: the first line of the reviewer's failed verdict ({gist}, in the reviewer's own words).

board.lane.roundFailed.description: Where a lane's card is, in its segment's label (Progress panel): its column ({where}, "Review"), and that its review round {round} failed.

board.lane.unrecorded.defaultMessage: {card} {title} · not recorded: the lane ended before Hive kept where its cards were
board.lane.unrecorded.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel), in a lane that ended before Hive recorded its cards' columns. {card} is the card’s name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none, {title} its title (the user's own words).

board.lane.unrecordedUntitled.defaultMessage: {card} · not recorded: the lane ended before Hive kept where its cards were
board.lane.unrecordedUntitled.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel), in a lane that ended before Hive recorded its cards' columns. {card} is the card’s name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.workChecks.defaultMessage: Checks on it: {passed, number} passed, {failed, number} failed
board.lane.workChecks.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel): how many of the checks on the card's revision passed and failed (each check's latest run that counted).

board.lane.workMerged.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel), for a Done card: the commit that merged it (a short commit id).

board.lane.workNoCode.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel): the card is a no-code card (its work isn't code), so it has no commits to show. Glossary: no-code card.

board.lane.workRefused.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel), for its red notch: the card's latest request was refused by its workflow rules: why ({message}) and what to do next ({next}), each a whole sentence already translated, then, when it was refused more than once in a row, how many times ({times}; nothing when once). Glossary: refused, rule.

board.lane.workRevision.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel): the card's revision (a short commit id, a3f2c1d), the one under review when the card is in Review.

board.lane.workStalePass.defaultMessage: {now, select, none {Pass was for {approved}: it no longer holds} other {Pass was for {approved}; now at {current}}}
board.lane.workStalePass.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel), with its stale mark: the card's pass was for one revision ({approved}, a short commit id) and the card is at another now ({current}); none: the revision now isn't known. Keep the select keys.

board.lane.workVerdict.defaultMessage: {pass, select, yes {Last verdict: passed} other {Last verdict: failed}}{revision, select, none {} other { on {revision}}}{current, select, no {, which no longer counts} other {}}
board.lane.workVerdict.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel): the card's last review verdict, passed or failed, on which revision (a short commit id; none for a card without one: keep that branch empty), and whether it no longer counts (a newer change or decision since). Keep the select keys as they are.

board.laneStart.addCard.description: The first entry of the Start Lane dialog's card picker: choosing a card adds it at the end of the lane's list. Todo is a board column.

board.laneStart.agentState.description: An agent in the Start Lane dialog's choices, with what it is doing ({status}: "Working…", "Not running").

board.laneStart.builder.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: the agent that builds the cards. Glossary: builder.

board.laneStart.busyNow.defaultMessage: {agents} {n, plural, one {is busy} other {are busy}} now: Wait and Start waits until {n, plural, one {it is} other {they are}} idle, then starts the lane.
board.laneStart.busyNow.description: In the Start Lane dialog: the chosen builder or reviewer ({agents}: their names, joined) can't start a new conversation now; the Wait and Start button waits for them.

board.laneStart.cancel.description: Button of the Start Lane dialog: closes it without starting anything (and stops waiting).

board.laneStart.cards.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: the cards the lane works through, in the order they are worked.

board.laneStart.down.description: Tooltip of a button in the Start Lane dialog: moves the card ({card}, its key) one place later in the lane.

board.laneStart.intro.defaultMessage: The builder works through the cards in this order, one at a time, and the reviewer reviews each. Both start in a new conversation with a brief: the cards, where the builder works, what the project’s rules ask, and your note.
board.laneStart.intro.description: At the top of the Start Lane dialog. Glossary: lane, rule.

board.laneStart.name.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: a short name for the lane, shown in the Progress panel.

board.laneStart.noAgents.defaultMessage: The project has no agents. Add one first.
board.laneStart.noAgents.description: In the Start Lane dialog: the chosen project has no agents to build the cards.

board.laneStart.noCards.defaultMessage: No cards yet: add them from the project’s Todo below.
board.laneStart.noCards.description: In the Start Lane dialog's list of cards, while none is chosen. Todo is a board column.

board.laneStart.noReviewer.description: A choice of the Start Lane dialog’s reviewer: the lane has none (the project’s rules may need one).

board.laneStart.notRunning.description: An agent's state in the Start Lane dialog's choices: its session isn't running (it starts with the brief).

board.laneStart.notStarted.description: A toast's title: the lane was recorded, but one of its agents ({agent}) couldn't be started. The reason follows.

board.laneStart.notStartedText.defaultMessage: {why} The lane is recorded: start {agent} yourself, or end the lane from its row in the Progress panel.
board.laneStart.notStartedText.description: The text of the toast when a lane's agent ({agent}) didn't start: why ({why}, a sentence), and what the user can do.

board.laneStart.note.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: anything the user wants both agents to know, added to their brief.

board.laneStart.project.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: the project whose cards the lane works through.

board.laneStart.remove.description: Tooltip of a button in the Start Lane dialog: removes the card ({card}, its key) from the lane's list (the card stays on the board).

board.laneStart.reviewer.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: the agent that reviews each card. Glossary: reviewer.

board.laneStart.show.description: A button on the toast after a lane started: shows its builder.

board.laneStart.start.description: Button of the Start Lane dialog: records the lane and starts both agents.

board.laneStart.started.description: A toast's title after a lane started from the window: its builder / reviewer ({pair}). Glossary: lane.

board.laneStart.startedText.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}. Each agent starts in a new conversation with its brief.
board.laneStart.startedText.description: The text of the toast after a lane started: how many cards ({n}), and that both agents started fresh with their brief.

board.laneStart.starting.description: The Start Lane button while the lane is being started.

board.laneStart.title.description: Title of the Start Lane dialog: a builder and a reviewer agent work through cards in turn (a lane, a card loop), started from the window. Glossary: lane.

board.laneStart.up.description: Tooltip of a button in the Start Lane dialog: moves the card ({card}, its key) one place earlier in the lane.

board.laneStart.waitAndStart.description: Button of the Start Lane dialog while the builder or reviewer is busy: waits until they are idle, then starts the lane.

board.laneStart.waiting.description: In the Start Lane dialog, after Wait and Start: it waits for the busy agents ({agents}: their names, joined) before starting the lane. Cancel stops waiting.

board.lanes.abandon.description: A lane's context menu item in the Progress panel: gives the lane up unmerged, after asking. Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.abandonConfirm.description: The confirm button of the question before abandoning a lane (Progress panel).

board.lanes.abandonMessage.defaultMessage: The lane stops here, unmerged: its cards stay where they are, and its agents are told no more. Start a new lane to carry on.
board.lanes.abandonMessage.description: The question before abandoning a lane (Progress panel): what abandoning does. Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.abandonTitle.description: Title of the question before abandoning a lane from the Progress panel: the lane's builder / reviewer and its name ({lane}). Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.alreadyEnd.defaultMessage: {where, select, first {{lane} is already the first running lane} other {{lane} is already the last running lane}}
board.lanes.alreadyEnd.description: Said to screen readers when a lane (its builder / reviewer: {lane}) is moved with Alt+Up or Alt+Down but is already first or last among the running lanes.

board.lanes.bar.defaultMessage: {pair}: {finished} of {total, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} finished
board.lanes.bar.description: Accessible name of a lane's bar (Progress panel): the builder / reviewer ({pair}), and how many of its cards are finished (passed or done).

board.lanes.barUnrecorded.defaultMessage: {pair}: {total, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}, not recorded
board.lanes.barUnrecorded.description: Accessible name of a lane's bar (Progress panel) when the lane ended before Hive recorded where its cards were: the builder / reviewer ({pair}) and how many cards.

board.lanes.edge.description: Accessible name of the handle on the top edge of the Progress panel's lanes: drag it for more or fewer lanes.

board.lanes.edgeTip.defaultMessage: Drag to show more or fewer lanes; double-click for {lanes}
board.lanes.edgeTip.description: Tooltip of the handle on the top edge of the Progress panel's lanes. {lanes} is the default number of lanes shown.

board.lanes.edgeValue.defaultMessage: {shown} of {count, plural, one {# lane} other {# lanes}} shown
board.lanes.edgeValue.description: The value of the handle on the top edge of the Progress panel's lanes, for screen readers: {shown} of the {count} lanes show.

board.lanes.end.description: A lane's context menu item in the Progress panel: ends the lane (its agents' card loop is over; the cards stay as they are). Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.endFailed.description: A toast's title: ending a lane from the Progress panel failed ({lane}: its builder / reviewer and name). The reason follows.

board.lanes.fold.description: Tooltip of the Progress panel's Lanes bar: folds the lanes down to the bar.

board.lanes.latestRun.defaultMessage: {card}'s latest run: {run}, {state, select, running {running} passed {passed} failed {failed} other {stopped}}
board.lanes.latestRun.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the dot after a lane's current card (Progress panel): that card's latest run ({run}: its title) and how it is going or went. Keep the select keys.

board.lanes.moveDown.description: A lane's context menu item in the Progress panel: moves it down among the running lanes.

board.lanes.moveUp.description: A lane's context menu item in the Progress panel: moves it up among the running lanes.

board.lanes.moved.defaultMessage: {lane} moved: {at} of {n, plural, one {# running lane} other {# running lanes}}
board.lanes.moved.description: Said to screen readers after a lane is moved in the Progress panel: the lane (its builder / reviewer, and its name in brackets), and its place now ({at}) among the {n} running lanes.

board.lanes.none.defaultMessage: No lanes. When a builder and a reviewer work through cards in turn (a card loop), their lane shows here with each card.
board.lanes.none.description: The Progress panel's Lanes tab when there are no lanes. Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.show.description: Tooltip of the Progress panel's Lanes bar when the lanes are folded away.

board.lanes.stalled.description: A lane's mark in its header (Progress panel), lower case: one of its cards is stalled (nobody is working on it); its tooltip says why.

board.lanes.start.description: A button in the Progress panel's Lanes tab and an item of a lane's menu: opens Start Lane (a builder and a reviewer agent work through cards in turn). Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.state.description: A lane's state in its header in the Progress panel, lower case (a lane: a builder and its reviewer working through cards in turn): paused, merged (it ended: its cards were merged) or abandoned.

board.lanes.title.description: The Progress panel's section of lanes (a builder and its reviewer working through cards in turn): its bar's label and accessible name.

board.lanes.usualOrder.description: A lane's context menu item in the Progress panel: puts the lanes back in their usual order, undoing the user's own.

board.lanes.usualOrderDetail.defaultMessage: Running lanes newest first, paused ones after them
board.lanes.usualOrderDetail.description: Under Usual Order in a lane's context menu (Progress panel): what the usual order is.

board.lanes.usualOrderSaid.defaultMessage: Lanes back in the usual order
board.lanes.usualOrderSaid.description: Said to screen readers after the Progress panel's lanes go back to their usual order (Usual Order, in a lane's menu).

board.lanes.waitingForYou.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# waiting for you} other {# waiting for you}}
board.lanes.waitingForYou.description: In the Progress panel's Lanes bar, after how many lanes there are: how many of them wait for the user's answer (an approval, a decision, a round limit). Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.waits.defaultMessage: {reason, select, blocked {{card} is blocked} hold {{card} is On Hold} you {waiting for you ({ask, select, approve {approval} decide {a decision} test {a test} signIn {a sign-in} other {an answer}}): {card}} roundLimit {waiting for you: {card} reached its round limit} notMerged {waiting: {card} not merged} merging {waiting: {card} merging} stale {stale: {card} must be submitted again} reviewer {waiting for a reviewer on {card}} other {list changes after {card}}}
board.lanes.waits.description: Why a lane (a builder and its reviewer working through cards) waits, in its header in the Progress panel, lower case. {card} is a card's name (its key, such as HI-12). reason: blocked or On Hold (a board column); waiting for the user (ask: for their approval, a decision, a test, a sign-in or another answer); at its round limit (the user decides how to go on); a card passed but not merged yet (or merging now), so the next can't start (one card at a time); its pass is stale (the builder must submit again); nobody reviews it; changes to the lane's list of cards apply once that card is done (other). Keep the select keys. Glossary: lane, round limit, stale.

board.links.archivedTitle.description: The hover of a card number (#12) in a terminal, for an archived card: its name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title (the user's own words), the column it was archived from ({column}), and how to open it.

board.links.title.description: The hover of a card number (#12) in a terminal: its name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title (the user's own words), its board column ({column}), and how to open it.

board.menu.delete.description: Menu item on a card (right-click): deletes it after asking.

board.menu.moveTo.description: A heading in a card's right-click menu, above the board columns it can move to.

board.menu.nextRound.description: Menu item on a card that failed review and is still in Review: returns it to its reviewer for the next round. Review is the board column.

board.menu.open.description: Menu item on a card (right-click): opens the card's dialog.

board.menu.start.description: Menu item on a card (right-click): gives it to an agent to start (opens a dialog).

board.menu.startLane.description: Menu item on a Todo card (right-click): opens Start Lane with this card first in the lane's list (a lane: a builder and a reviewer working through cards in turn). Glossary: lane.

board.merge.fold.defaultMessage: Fold the merge to one line
board.merge.fold.description: Tooltip of the button folding a merge's card in the Progress panel to its first line.

board.merge.region.description: Accessible name of the top of the Progress panel: a card for each merge going on.

board.merge.time.description: How long a merge has held the merge slot ({sofar}: "3 min") and how long its hold has left ({left}: "57 min"), on its card in the Progress panel.

board.merge.timeOver.description: How long a merge has held the merge slot ({sofar}: "63 min"), on its card in the Progress panel, once its hold has run out.

board.merge.unfold.description: Tooltip of the button unfolding a merge's card in the Progress panel.

board.move.anyway.description: The button of the question before a move that skips rules: makes the move, recording it as an override (glossary: override).

board.move.askDetail.defaultMessage: Moving it anyway records an override on the card, with your reason.
board.move.askDetail.description: Under the rules a move would skip, in the question before it: making the move records it on the card as an exception to the rules (glossary: override), with the reason the user gives below.

board.move.askMessage.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {This skips a rule of its project:} other {This skips # rules of its project:}}
board.move.askMessage.description: The question before a move that skips workflow rules (glossary: rule): how many it skips ({n}), listed below by name. Moving anyway records an exception on the card (glossary: override), with the reason the user gives.

board.move.askTitle.description: Title of the question before a move that skips some of the card's workflow rules (glossary: rule). {card} is the card's name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12), {column} the board column it is moved to.

board.move.notMoved.defaultMessage: Your other changes are saved; the card stays in {column}.
board.move.notMoved.description: In the card dialog, after Save: the user changed the card's Column, but its move was cancelled or refused (a toast says why); everything else was saved. {column} is the board column it is in.

board.move.reason.description: The label of the field in the question before a move that skips rules: why the user makes the exception, kept with it on the card. Optional.

board.move.refused.description: A toast's title: a card's move was refused for something no exception to the rules can make true (nothing to submit, something Hive couldn't read). {card} is the card's name, {column} a board column. The toast's text says why and what to do.

board.move.stopped.description: A toast's title: a drag went part of the way (the card's work started) and stopped in {column} (a board column), for something no exception to the rules can make true. {card} is the card's name. The toast's text says why and what to do.

board.newCard.button.description: The board toolbar's button that adds a card, and the title of the dialog it opens.

board.newCard.tip.description: Tooltip on the + buttons that add a card (the Todo column, the Board sidebar).

board.overview.blocked.description: A count on the Overview's board strip: cards that are blocked (can't go on). Follows the number.

board.overview.noCards.description: A project's Overview, where its cards are counted, when it has none.

board.overview.openTasks.description: Button on a project's Overview with no cards: opens its Tasks tab.

board.overview.stalled.description: Cards nobody is getting on with, counted: on the Overview's board strip (after the number) and as a heading in the Board sidebar.

board.overview.waitingForReview.description: Cards in the Review column, counted: on the Overview's board strip (after the number) and as a heading in the Board sidebar.

board.panel.allProjects.description: The Board sidebar's first row: shows every project's cards.

board.panel.info.defaultMessage: The workspace's cards, in .hive/tasks. Agents and the Assistant read, change and move them through Hive's tools (finished work goes to Review); only you archive or delete them.
board.panel.info.description: The (i) beside the Board sidebar's title. Keep .hive/tasks as it is (a folder). Review is a board column.

board.panel.refresh.description: Tooltip on the Board sidebar's refresh button: reads the cards again.

board.panel.stalledInfo.defaultMessage: Cards in Doing that nobody is working on: no agent has them, or their agent was removed or isn't running. Also cards in Doing or Review that an agent in a card loop left without waiting on them.
board.panel.stalledInfo.description: The (i) beside the Board sidebar's Stalled heading. Doing and Review are board columns.

board.panel.workspace.description: A row of the Board sidebar: shows the cards of no project (about the whole workspace).

board.progress.agentGone.description: Why a Progress panel run's agent can't be shown: the agent ({agent}) was removed from its project ({project}).

board.progress.allAgents.description: A choice of the Progress panel's agent filter: the runs of every agent of the chosen project.

board.progress.allProjects.description: A choice of the Progress panel's project filter: every project's runs.

board.progress.anAgent.description: Who ran a run in the Progress panel when Hive doesn't have the agent's name (an older record).

board.progress.attention.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# run failed} other {# runs failed}}
board.progress.attention.description: A line in the Progress panel's Pulse tab: runs failed and no later run of the same thing passed since; a click shows them in the Runs tab.

board.progress.badgeLanes.description: What the badge on the Progress panel's Lanes tab means: how many lanes there are.

board.progress.badgeMerges.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# merge waiting} other {# merges waiting}}
board.progress.badgeMerges.description: What the badge on the Progress panel's Merges tab means: how many agents wait for the merge slot.

board.progress.badgeRuns.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# failure nothing has passed since} other {# failures nothing has passed since}}
board.progress.badgeRuns.description: What the red badge on the Progress panel's Runs tab means: runs that failed with no later run of the same thing passing.

board.progress.blocksReview.description: Under a failed run in the Progress panel: the run was a check the card's rules require before it can go to Review, so the card can't until it passes. {card} is the card's name (its key, such as HI-12). Glossary: check, rule.

board.progress.cantShow.description: A notification's title: the agent ({agent}) that ran a Progress panel run can't be shown. Its message says why.

board.progress.copied.description: A notification after copying a run's command or its details from the Progress panel.

board.progress.copyCommand.description: Button in a run's details (Progress panel): copies the command it ran.

board.progress.copyDetails.description: Button in a run's details (Progress panel): copies all of them as text, to paste elsewhere.

board.progress.copyFailed.defaultMessage: {what, select, command {Could not copy the command} other {Could not copy the details}}
board.progress.copyFailed.description: A notification: copying a run's command or its details from the Progress panel failed.

board.progress.copyRevision.description: Tooltip of a run's revision in the Progress panel (under its agent): copies the whole commit id. {revision} is its short form (a3f2c1d).

board.progress.detailsOf.description: Accessible name of a run's details in the Progress panel ({run}: the run's title).

board.progress.dismiss.defaultMessage: Dismiss (it stays in the Runs tab)
board.progress.dismiss.description: Tooltip of the button dismissing a failed or stale run in the Progress panel's Pulse tab. Runs is the panel's tab of every run (keep it as the panel names it).

board.progress.empty.defaultMessage: Nothing is running. When an agent runs tests or a build with progress reporting, it shows here with how far along it is and the time left.
board.progress.empty.description: The Progress panel when it has no runs.

board.progress.filterAgent.description: Accessible name of the Progress panel's agent filter, continuing the project filter's (Show the runs of): a list of the project's agents follows.

board.progress.filterProject.description: Accessible name of the Progress panel's project filter (a list of projects follows; the agent filter's name continues the sentence: …and of the agent).

board.progress.fold.description: Tooltip of the button folding the Progress panel to a strip at the window's edge. A shortcut may follow in brackets.

board.progress.hideDetails.description: Tooltip of the button closing a run's details in the Progress panel ({run}: the run's title).

board.progress.miniWaiting.description: Tooltip of a run's small bar on the folded Progress strip: its agent, its title ({run}), and that it is waiting (for a test slot, say).

board.progress.moreOthers.defaultMessage: and {n, number} others: open the panel to see them
board.progress.moreOthers.description: The last line of the folded Progress strip's +N tooltip, after the runs it lists: how many more there are ({n}).

board.progress.moreRuns.description: Heading of the folded Progress strip's +N tooltip: the runs without a bar of their own ({n} of them) are listed under it.

board.progress.noAssistant.defaultMessage: The Assistant is not in this workspace.
board.progress.noAssistant.description: Why a Progress panel run's agent can't be shown: the run is the Hive Assistant's, and this workspace has none.

board.progress.noMerges.defaultMessage: No merge is going on. While an agent merges its branch, it shows here with its cards, its checks and who waits.
board.progress.noMerges.description: The Progress panel's Merges tab when no agent is merging.

board.progress.openCard.description: Tooltip of a run's card in the Progress panel (under its agent): opens the card. {card} is the card's reference (#1061).

board.progress.openLog.description: Button in a run's details (Progress panel): opens the log file its reporter named.

board.progress.openLogFailed.description: An error's title: opening a run's log file (Progress panel) failed.

board.progress.projectGone.defaultMessage: Its project is no longer in this workspace.
board.progress.projectGone.description: Why a Progress panel run's agent can't be shown: its project was removed from the workspace.

board.progress.railFiltered.description: The folded Progress strip's name when the panel is filtered: the project (or project · agent) shown ({name}), its runs in words ({summary}: 3 runs: 2 running, 1 failed), and how many runs there are in all ({all}).

board.progress.railFilteredNone.defaultMessage: {name} only: no runs; {all, number} in all
board.progress.railFilteredNone.description: The folded Progress strip's name when the panel is filtered and the project (or project · agent) shown ({name}) has no runs: how many runs there are in all ({all}).

board.progress.railLabel.description: The folded Progress panel's label, written down the strip at the window's edge. Keep it short.

board.progress.railShowing.description: Tooltip of the filter mark on the folded Progress strip: only one project's (or agent's) runs ({name}) show, {shown} of {all} runs.

board.progress.recentHover.description: Tooltip of a run in the Progress panel's Runs tab: its agent, its title ({run}) and its state in a few words ({state}: failed, stopped reporting…).

board.progress.recentHoverTook.description: Tooltip of a run in the Progress panel's Runs tab: its agent, its title ({run}), its state in a few words ({state}: failed, stopped reporting…) and how long it took ({took}: 4 min).

board.progress.region.description: Accessible name of the Progress panel (long runs agents report: tests, builds).

board.progress.revisionCopied.description: A notification after copying a run's revision (a commit id) from the Progress panel. {revision} is its short form (a3f2c1d).

board.progress.revisionCopyFailed.description: A notification: copying a run's revision (a commit id) from the Progress panel failed.

board.progress.script.description: Who ran a run in the Progress panel when a script (a program calling Hive's Agent API) ran it, not an agent.

board.progress.scriptRun.defaultMessage: A script reported it, not an agent: there is no agent to show.
board.progress.scriptRun.description: Why a Progress panel run's agent can't be shown: a script reported the run.

board.progress.show.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the folded Progress strip at the window's edge: opens the panel. Its runs in words, or a shortcut, may follow in brackets.

board.progress.showAgent.description: Accessible name of the button showing the agent ({agent}) that ran a Progress panel run ({run}: the run's title).

board.progress.showAssistant.description: Accessible name of the button showing the Hive Assistant, which ran a Progress panel run ({run}: the run's title).

board.progress.showDetails.description: Tooltip of the button opening a run's details in the Progress panel ({run}: the run's title).

board.progress.showLog.description: Button in a run's details (Progress panel): shows its log file in File Explorer.

board.progress.showLogFailed.description: An error's title: showing a run's log file in its folder (Progress panel) failed.

board.progress.showTheAgent.description: Button and tooltip on a Progress panel run: shows the agent that ran it.

board.progress.stepOf.description: A run's step in the Progress panel, under its bar: step {step} of {total}.

board.progress.stepOfNamed.description: A run's step in the Progress panel, under its bar: step {step} of {total}, and the step's name ({name}, as its reporter named it).

board.progress.tab.description: A tab of the Progress panel: Pulse (an overview of what is going on now), Merges, Runs (tests, builds and checks agents ran) or Lanes (card loops). Keep "Runs" as the panel says it everywhere. Keep the select keys.

board.progress.tabs.description: Accessible name of the Progress panel's tabs (Pulse, Merges, Runs, Lanes).

board.progress.title.description: The Progress panel's title, in its header (long runs agents report: tests, builds).

board.progress.waiting.description: A run's state on its bar (accessible value) and in a list of runs (build (waiting)), lower case: it waits (for a test slot, say).

board.readOnly.newer.defaultMessage: This board was saved by a newer version of Hive: it is read-only here.
board.readOnly.newer.description: Tooltip on what changes cards (the board's add-card buttons, the card dialog's Save, comments and decisions), disabled while the board was saved by a newer Hive (whose format this one can't change); also a banner in the card dialog.

board.restore09.done.description: A notification after the 0.9 board backup was put back.

board.restore09.doneDetail.description: Under "The 0.9 board is back": {file} is the file the board as it was before the restore was saved to.

board.restore09.message.defaultMessage: Hive keeps a copy of the board as it is now, then puts back the copy made before its upgrade to 1.0 ({when}). Changes made since are only in the kept copy. The board is then read-only here: quit this Hive and open the workspace in Hive 0.9 to carry on.
board.restore09.message.description: The confirmation before restoring the 0.9 board backup. {when} is when the backup was made (a date and time).

board.restore09.none.defaultMessage: There is no 0.9 board backup to restore
board.restore09.none.description: A notification from Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup… when the workspace has no copy of its board from before an upgrade to 1.0.

board.restore09.restore.description: The button of the confirmation: puts the 0.9 board backup back.

board.restore09.restoring.description: The Restore button while the 0.9 board backup is put back.

board.restore09.title.description: Title of the confirmation before Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup… puts back the copy of the board Hive kept when it upgraded it to 1.0.

board.review.line.description: A card's reviewer line on the board: who is reviewing it and since when ({ago}: "5 min ago").

board.review.lineNotRunning.description: A card's reviewer line on the board, in amber: its reviewer's session isn't running.

board.review.lineRemoved.description: A card's reviewer line on the board, in amber: its reviewer was removed from the project.

board.review.tip.defaultMessage: {agent} is reviewing it (since {ago}). Click to show it.
board.review.tip.description: Tooltip on a card's reviewer line: who is reviewing it, since when ({ago}: "5 min ago").

board.review.tipNotRunning.defaultMessage: {agent} started reviewing it {ago}, and isn't running.
board.review.tipNotRunning.description: Tooltip on a card's reviewer line, in amber: the reviewer ({agent}) started {ago} ("5 min ago") but its session isn't running now.

board.review.tipRemoved.defaultMessage: {agent} started reviewing it {ago}, and was removed.
board.review.tipRemoved.description: Tooltip on a card's reviewer line, in amber: the reviewer ({agent}) started {ago} ("5 min ago") and was removed from the project since.

board.run.agentStopped.defaultMessage: Its agent stopped before it finished
board.run.agentStopped.description: A run's status line in the Progress panel: the agent that ran it stopped first.

board.run.failedAfter.description: A failed run's status line in the Progress panel. {took} is how long it ran ("4 min").

board.run.finishing.description: A running run's status line in the Progress panel, just past its estimate. {took} is how long it has run ("3 min").

board.run.goneAfter.description: A run's status line in the Progress panel: its process ended without saying how it went. {took} is how long it ran ("4 min").

board.run.overEstimate.description: A running run's status line in the Progress panel, well past its estimate. {took} is how long it has run ("3 min").

board.run.passedIn.description: A finished run's status line in the Progress panel. {took} is how long it took ("4 min").

board.run.ranThenWaiting.description: A run's status line in the Progress panel: it ran for {took}, then has been waiting (for a test slot, say) for {waited}. Both are durations ("3 min").

board.run.staleFor.description: A run's status line in the Progress panel: no news from it for a while. {ago} is how long ("12 min").

board.run.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, running {running} failed {failed} stale {stopped reporting} passed {passed} stopped {stopped} gone {ended without a report} other {{state}}}
board.run.state.description: A Progress panel run's state in a few words, lower case: in a hover ("Copy the summary (failed)") and a run's accessible name. stale: it stopped reporting; gone: its process ended without saying how it went.

board.run.stoppedAfter.description: A run's status line in the Progress panel: its command was interrupted. {took} is how long it ran ("4 min").

board.run.timeLeft.description: A running run's status line in the Progress panel: how long it has run ({took}) and about how long it has left ({left}). Both are durations ("3 min").

board.run.waiting.description: A run's status line in the Progress panel: it has been waiting (for a test slot, say) for {waited} ("3 min"). Lower case, as the line may follow a duration.

board.run.wordsStale.description: A run in a few words, for an agent's status line: {run} is its title and steps ("e2e 4/12"); it stopped reporting.

board.run.wordsWaiting.description: A run in a few words, for an agent's status line: {run} is its title and steps ("e2e 4/12"); it is waiting (for a test slot, say).

board.runs.agent.description: Accessible name of the Progress panel's Runs tab filter by agent: only the runs one agent ran.

board.runs.anyAgent.description: A choice of the Progress panel's Runs tab filter by agent: runs of every agent.

board.runs.anyLane.description: A choice of the Progress panel's Runs tab filter by lane: runs of any card.

board.runs.cardRun.description: A run named with its card in the Progress panel's Runs tab: the card's name ({card}: its key, such as AL-12) and the run's title ({run}).

board.runs.clear.description: A button in the Progress panel's Runs tab: clears its filters and search.

board.runs.failedOnly.description: A toggle in the Progress panel's Runs tab: shows only the runs that failed.

board.runs.group.defaultMessage: {what} ×{n, number} · {outcome, select, passed {{failed, plural, =0 {all passed} one {# failed, then passed} other {# failed, then passed}}} failed {{failed, plural, one {# failed} other {# failed}}} other {{failed, plural, =0 {last stopped} one {# failed, last stopped} other {# failed, last stopped}}}}
board.runs.group.description: A line in the Progress panel's Runs tab for one run tried several times the same day: what ran ({what}: a card and the run's title), how many times ({n}), how many of them failed ({failed}) and how the last one ended (outcome: passed, failed, or stopped without passing or failing). Keep the select keys.

board.runs.lane.description: Accessible name of the Progress panel's Runs tab filter by lane: only the runs for a lane's cards.

board.runs.none.defaultMessage: No runs yet. When an agent runs tests or a build with progress reporting, every run shows here, kept by day.
board.runs.none.description: The Progress panel's Runs tab when Hive has no runs.

board.runs.noneMatch.description: The Progress panel's Runs tab when no run matches its filters or search.

board.runs.search.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search box in the Progress panel's Runs tab: finds runs by title, command, agent or card.

board.runs.today.description: A heading in the Progress panel's Runs tab: the runs that ended today follow.

board.runs.yesterday.description: A heading in the Progress panel's Runs tab: the runs that ended yesterday follow.

board.setAside.add.description: Button: adds the set-aside card to the board as a new card.

board.setAside.added.description: A notification: the set-aside card was added to the board with this number.

board.setAside.adding.description: The Add to Board button while the card is being added.

board.setAside.close.description: Button: closes the dialog listing set-aside cards.

board.setAside.discard.description: Button: discards the set-aside card (asks first). The … says it asks: keep it.

board.setAside.discardButton.description: Button in the confirmation: discards the set-aside card.

board.setAside.discardMessage.defaultMessage: It doesn't reach the board: its file goes to the Recycle Bin{readable, select, yes {, with its comments and history} other {}}.
board.setAside.discardMessage.description: The confirmation before a set-aside card is discarded; readable (yes) when it is a card, not a damaged file. Recycle Bin is Windows' name for it.

board.setAside.discardTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before a set-aside card is discarded. {title} is its title.

board.setAside.discarding.description: The Discard button while the card is being discarded.

board.setAside.intro.defaultMessage: This workspace was opened in an older Hive, which saved these cards where it keeps them. They were set aside, unchanged, and not added to the board. Add each one, or discard it.
board.setAside.intro.description: The top of the dialog listing cards an older Hive saved.

board.setAside.keeps.description: Beside a set-aside card: its old number {n} is free on this board, so Add gives it that number.

board.setAside.links.defaultMessage: Nothing is rewritten for them: a card here that links to one by its old number keeps that number, and a card added under a new number keeps its own links as they were.
board.setAside.links.description: A note in the dialog listing cards an older Hive saved: Hive changes no references between cards when adding them.

board.setAside.loading.description: The dialog listing cards an older Hive saved, while it reads them.

board.setAside.made.description: Who made a set-aside card ({by}: a name, You or Assistant) and when ({when}: a date and time).

board.setAside.menu.description: An item of the board's ⋯ menu, shown while cards an older Hive saved are set aside: opens the dialog to add or discard them. {n} is how many. The … says it opens a dialog: keep it.

board.setAside.none.description: The dialog listing cards an older Hive saved, when none are left.

board.setAside.number.description: A set-aside card's number as the older Hive gave it. {n} is the number (after #).

board.setAside.taken.defaultMessage: #{n} is taken here: Add gives the next free number
board.setAside.taken.description: Beside a set-aside card: a card on this board has its old number {n}, so Add gives it a new one.

board.setAside.title.defaultMessage: Cards Made by an Older Hive
board.setAside.title.description: Title of the dialog listing cards an older version of Hive saved in this workspace after the board moved to its database; they were kept aside, not added to the board.

board.setAside.unreadable.defaultMessage: This file isn't a card Hive can read: it can only be discarded.
board.setAside.unreadable.description: A set-aside file that is not a valid card.

board.setAside.where.defaultMessage: {project, select, none {The workspace} other {{project}}} · {column} · {comments, plural, =0 {no comments} one {# comment} other {# comments}}
board.setAside.where.description: A set-aside card's project (a folder name; none: about the whole workspace), its board column, and how many comments it has.

board.slots.agentMerging.description: Who holds the merge slot: an agent ({agent}) merging, then the cards it merges ({cards}: "#305, #306"; none: leave that branch empty).

board.slots.agentNext.defaultMessage: {agent} is next to merge{cards, select, none {} other { {cards}}}
board.slots.agentNext.description: Who holds the merge slot: an agent ({agent}) whose turn it is, not started yet, then the cards it will merge ({cards}: "#305, #306"; none: leave that branch empty).

board.slots.free.description: A merge slot nobody holds, after its branch ("main: free"). Lower case.

board.slots.freeNext.description: A merge slot nobody holds, after its branch ("main: free, B4 next"): the agent next in line ({agent}) gets it. Lower case.

board.slots.held.description: A merge slot in a line, after its branch: who holds it ({holder}: "B4 is merging #305"), how long so far ({sofar}: "3 min") and how long its hold has left ({left}: "57 min").

board.slots.heldOver.description: A merge slot in a line, after its branch: who holds it ({holder}: "B4 is merging #305"), how long so far ({sofar}: "63 min"), and that its hold has run out.

board.slots.into.description: Where a merge goes: into a branch ({branch}, shown as code; keep the <code> tags around it).

board.slots.line.description: A merge slot in the Progress panel: its branch ({name}, shown as code: keep the <branch> tags around it) and who holds it or waits for it ({state}). Your language's punctuation goes around the colon.

board.slots.minutes.description: How long a merge has held the merge slot (or has left), in whole minutes ("48 min"). Keep it short: an abbreviation.

board.slots.note.defaultMessage: {who} into {branch} (the merge slot). Merge waits until it is free{waiting, plural, =0 {} other {; # waiting}}.
board.slots.note.description: The Merge dialog's note while the branch it merges into ({branch}) is taken: who holds it ({who}: "B4 is merging #305"), that the merge waits, and how many wait in line ({waiting}; none: leave that branch empty).

board.slots.release.description: Button on a merge slot: frees the slot from a holder that is stuck. Keep it short.

board.slots.releaseAgent.defaultMessage: {agent} holds the merge slot for {project} · {branch}. Release it only if it is stuck: {agent} may be in the middle of merging, and is told the slot was released when it next asks.
board.slots.releaseAgent.description: The confirmation before freeing a merge slot an agent ({agent}) holds, for a project ({project}) and its branch ({branch}).

board.slots.releaseFailed.description: An error's title: freeing a merge slot failed.

board.slots.releaseNext.defaultMessage: {agent} is next in line and gets it.
board.slots.releaseNext.description: Under the confirmation before freeing a merge slot: the agent next in line ({agent}) gets the slot.

board.slots.releaseTipAgent.defaultMessage: Release the merge slot {agent} holds, if it is stuck
board.slots.releaseTipAgent.description: Tooltip of the Release button on a merge slot an agent ({agent}) holds.

board.slots.releaseTipYou.defaultMessage: Release the merge slot your merge holds, if it is stuck
board.slots.releaseTipYou.description: Tooltip of the Release button on a merge slot the user's own merge holds.

board.slots.releaseTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before freeing a merge slot from its holder.

board.slots.releaseYours.defaultMessage: Your merge holds the merge slot for {project} · {branch}. Release it only if it is stuck: the merge may still be running.
board.slots.releaseYours.description: The confirmation before freeing a merge slot the user's own merge holds, for a project ({project}) and its branch ({branch}).

board.slots.underMinute.description: How long a merge has held the merge slot (or has left), when under a minute. Lower case: it starts a phrase ("under a minute so far").

board.slots.waiting.description: Who waits for the merge slot, in line order ({agents}: their names, listed).
